content:
Hello World I keep coming across little things that are worth noting down. These are things like a command that saves a few clicks, a setting that I keep forgetting or a check that I should have run an hour earlier.
I’ll use Field Notes to share short tips and tricks from my day-to-day work and homelab, providing enough context for you to try them yourself. I’ll probably refer to a few of them myself.
